## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization / Constant-time enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code cleanup

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly under `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror`
- [ ] `make check-format` passes without any formatting errors
- [ ] `make test` unit test suite passes 100%
- [ ] `make lint` static analysis completes without errors
- [ ] Added or updated documentation in `docs/` where applicable
- [ ] License comment headers are included in all new files
